note: Both sets cover the core table values (E=2.00E11 Pa, G=7.93E10 Pa, ρ=7.85E3 kg/m3, Gs=140E6 Pa, νs=0.4), the 0.170 Hz first tower-monopile mode, the 0.10–0.13 Hz wave range and the 30 m clearance with 120-m blades, and both are heavily duplicated. Set A adds the 150 m hub height and 10-m monopile outer diameter that B omits, but it also invents a 0.12 Hz JONSWAP peak value, twice misreads the tower frequency as 0.18 Hz against the stated 0.170 Hz, and garbles the steel shear modulus (793E3 Pa) and density (785E3 kg/m3). Set B adds the 100 t transition piece mass and the 20–30 m clearance range, and its errors are fewer: one 0.18 Hz misread, one mangled density (785E3 kg/m^5) and two soil properties misbound to the Tower entity. On balance B makes fewer wrong or fabricated claims while keeping comparable coverage.
